title: YouTube Music launches new labels as AI-generated music floods streaming platforms
hook_text: YouTube Music is labeling AI songs
script:
YouTube Music is rolling out new labels as AI-generated music floods streaming platforms.
The labels will appear directly on the player page for every listener.
They will mark songs entirely generated by AI or partially crafted with it.
This includes tracks where algorithms were involved in composition and vocals.
Streaming services have faced an unprecedented wave of synthetic tracks uploaded daily.
Listeners can now instantly identify algorithmic audio before finishing a track.
Would you skip an algorithmic song?
